budget_items.topic: School FY18 budget (reported by Ms. Luck from School Committee)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Superintendent Calmes said the FY18 school budget will rise over FY17 by a stated amount to a stated total.
budget_items.quote: the fy18 budget will reflect a $1,172,864 increase over fy17 with a total budget of $19,628,762.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Board signed four warrants: payroll, payroll deductions, Middle/High School construction, and accounts payable.
budget_items.quote: the board signed a payroll warrant in the amount of $726,019.98; a payroll deductions warrant in the amount of $160,394.54; a middle/high school construction warrant in the amount of $732,083.42 and an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $629,014.82.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Manager said free cash should be certified by the MA Dept. of Revenue by the end of the week; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: she reported free cash should be certified by the ma dept. of revenue by the end of the week.

budget_items.topic: School resource police officer funding request (public comment)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Katie Adams requested additional funding for a school resource police officer; no amount printed.
budget_items.quote: she requested additional funding to provide for this position.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Entering the Community Compact by February 15 would make the town eligible for the IT Grant due April 15; no grant amount printed.
budget_items.quote: as that would make the town eligible for the it grant that is due april 15.

budget_items.topic: Efficiency and Regionalization Grant - permitting software
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Individual efficiency application grant funding goes up to a figure described as the approximate cost of implementing the permitting software.
budget_items.quote: for an individual application efficiency measure, grant funding goes up to $100,000, which is the approximate cost of the implementation of that software.

budget_items.topic: Efficiency and Regionalization Grant - multi-jurisdictional (Regional Animal Control)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Multi-jurisdictional grant funding goes up to a stated amount, which could cover the first year's costs, a new kennel and possibly an Animal Control vehicle.
budget_items.quote: for the multi-jurisdictional application, grant funding goes up to $200,000.
